# EHI Heating And Cooling

> EHI Heating And Cooling (Efficient Home Improvements) is a licensed residential and commercial HVAC contractor in Ontario, Canada, with 20+ years of experience. We install, repair and maintain heat pumps, furnaces, air conditioners, ductless mini-splits and tankless water heaters, and handle Home Renovation Savings Program heat pump rebate paperwork.

- Phone: 1-647-694-5845
- Email: efficienthomecomfort@gmail.com
- Office: 4261 Bloomington Road, Whitchurch-Stouffville, ON L4A 3Y6 (service-area business; crews come to you)
- Hours: Monday 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM; Tuesday 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM; Wednesday 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM; Thursday 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM; Friday 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM; Saturday 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM; Sunday 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM
- Service area: the GTA, York, Durham, Peel, Halton, Simcoe, Niagara, Hamilton, Kitchener-Waterloo, Ottawa, and towns across Eastern, Southwestern and Northern Ontario
- Authorized dealer: Midea, Lennox, Kepler and Rinnai. Also installs and services Goodman.
- Prices: furnaces installed from $3,300, cold-climate heat pumps from $5,500, tankless water heaters from $3,300. Every job gets a written, guaranteed quote.
- Voted Best Company 2019 to 2021 on HomeStars
- Free quote: [https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/contact/](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/contact/)

## Services and brands

- [All HVAC Services](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/services/): Every heating, cooling, water heating and air quality service we offer across Ontario.
- [HVAC Installation & Replacement](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/services/hvac-installation-replacement/): Full system replacements: furnace, AC, heat pump or all three, sized right and installed in a day.
- [HVAC Repair & Maintenance](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/services/hvac-repair-maintenance/): Diagnosis, honest repair quotes and tune-ups that keep your system out of trouble.
- [Emergency HVAC Service](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/services/emergency-hvac/): No heat or no cooling? Same-day emergency furnace and AC repair across Ontario.
- [Heat Pump Installation](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/heat-pump/): Cold-climate heat pump installation with up to $7,500 in Ontario rebates.
- [Heat Pump Repair & Maintenance](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/heat-pump/repair-maintenance/): Heat pump not heating or cooling? Repairs and tune-ups for every brand.
- [Cold Climate Heat Pumps](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/heat-pump/cold-climate/): Heat pumps rated to -30°C that replace your furnace and AC in one.
- [Ducted (Central) Heat Pumps](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/heat-pump/central/): Central heat pumps that use your existing ductwork to heat and cool the whole house.
- [Hybrid Furnace + Heat Pump](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/heat-pump/hybrid-furnace-systems/): Dual-fuel systems: heat pump most of the year, gas furnace on the coldest nights.
- [Heat Pump + Electric Air Handler](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/heat-pump/electric-air-handler-systems/): All-electric central heating and cooling for homes without gas.
- [Furnace Installation & Replacement](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/furnace/): High-efficiency Lennox and Midea gas furnaces, from $3,300 installed.
- [Furnace Repair & Tune-Up](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/furnace/repair-maintenance/): Furnace not heating? Repairs, blower motors, ignitors and annual maintenance.
- [High-Efficiency Furnaces](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/furnace/high-efficiency/): 96% to 97% AFUE two-stage, variable-speed furnaces that cut gas bills.
- [Electric Furnaces & Air Handlers](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/furnace/electric-air-handlers/): Electric heating and air handlers for homes without gas, or paired with a heat pump.
- [AC Installation & Replacement](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/ac/): Central air conditioner installation and replacement, sized for Ontario summers.
- [AC Repair & Tune-Up](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/ac/repair-maintenance/): AC not cooling, leaking or short cycling? Fast repair and seasonal maintenance.
- [Ductless Mini-Split Installation](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/ac/ductless-mini-split/): Heat and cool rooms without ductwork: single-zone mini-split heat pumps.
- [Ductless Mini-Split Repair](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/ac/ductless-mini-split/repair/): Mini-split repair, cleaning and maintenance for any brand.
- [Multi-Zone Ductless Systems](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/ac/multi-zone-ductless-system/): One outdoor unit, up to five indoor heads, each room on its own thermostat.
- [Tankless Water Heater Installation](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/water-heater/): Rinnai condensing tankless water heaters, endless hot water from $3,300.
- [Tankless Water Heater Repair](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/water-heater/repair-maintenance/): Rinnai and other tankless repair, descaling flush and maintenance.
- [Humidifiers](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/services/humidifiers/): Whole-home furnace humidifiers to fix dry winter air, static and cracked trim.
- [HRV & ERV Systems](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/services/hrv-erv/): Fresh air ventilation for tight homes: installation, repair and cleaning.
- [Thermostats](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/services/thermostats/): Smart and heat-pump-ready thermostat installation and replacement.
- [Midea Heat Pumps](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/brands/midea-heat-pumps/): Midea EVOX G3 and Extreme Hyper Heat cold-climate heat pumps, 2 to 5 ton.
- [Midea Ductless Mini-Splits](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/brands/midea-ductless-mini-splits/): Midea Hyper Heat single-zone and multi-zone ductless systems.
- [Midea Furnaces & Air Handlers](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/brands/midea-furnace-air-handlers/): Midea MGH96 furnaces and EVOX G3 electric air handlers.
- [Lennox Furnaces](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/brands/lennox-furnaces/): Lennox ML296V and EL297V two-stage, variable-speed gas furnaces.
- [Lennox Air Conditioners](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/brands/lennox-air-conditioners/): Lennox central air conditioners installed by an authorized dealer.
- [Lennox Heat Pumps](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/brands/lennox-heat-pumps/): Lennox heat pumps and cold-climate options.
- [Kepler Heat Pumps](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/brands/kepler-heat-pumps/): Kepler cold-climate heat pumps built for Canadian winters.
- [Rinnai Tankless Water Heaters](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/brands/rinnai-tankless-water-heaters/): Rinnai RX160iN and RX199iN condensing tankless water heaters.
- [Goodman Furnaces, AC & Heat Pumps](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/brands/goodman/): Goodman GMVC96 furnaces, GSXH5 central air and GSZH5 heat pumps, installed and serviced.
- [Heat Pump Rebates Ontario](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/heat-pump-rebates/): Up to $7,500 through the Home Renovation Savings Program. We handle the paperwork.
- [HVAC Financing](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/financing/): 0% interest for 3, 6 or 9 months, or open loans from 2.99% OAC.
- [Offers](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/offers/): Guaranteed final pricing and we may beat comparable quotes by up to 10%.
- [Warranty](https://efficienthomeimprovements.ca/warranty/): Up to 12 years parts and labour on select systems.
